column1: # Hudhud's knowledge atoms (Marhala 9, lane B, D16; 26 Nov 2026). One row per atom: what a shop word means, told with its
# source and the day the source was read. The wording is the app's own, in its nine languages (the string keys below, in
# app/src/main/res/values*/strings.xml); no source's text is copied. Module 1: the numbers of the book; module 2: price and profit.
# source_tier: 1 law, standard or regulator; 2 government guidance; 3 university or open textbook; 4 professional publisher;
# 5 blog or forum (never alone). An AI is never a source. reviewed_by: "pending" until a person has read the atom against its
# source (the card then says "general guidance"); a reviewer writes "owner:YYYY-MM-DD" or their name and the day.
# Checked by scripts/check_knowledge_atoms.py, which also writes HudhudKnowledgeAtoms.kt from this file (--write).
